$comment: Diagnostic probes from Hooked (mapping §3). For onboarding/retention diagnosis.

probes.text: What does the customer do right before the moment they need [offer] — and what do they feel at that moment?

signal_interpretation.positive: Internal trigger (emotion/context) specifically identified — onboarding can be scheduled right when that emotion arises
signal_interpretation.negative: Not knowing the triggering context/emotion — onboarding will miss the timing; additional friction

probes.text: How many steps from when the customer feels a need to receiving the first value — and which ones can be removed?

signal_interpretation.positive: Alur terpetakan + langkah minimal; time-to-value singkat — friction rendah
signal_interpretation.negative: Banyak langkah / tidak terpetakan — onboarding friction tinggi; user hilang sebelum nilai pertama

probes.text: Dari 6 element simplicity (waktu, uang, effort, brain cycles, social deviance, non-routine), mana yang paling langka di customer saat ini?

signal_interpretation.positive: Scarcest resource identified — improvement can be focused on one obstacle.
signal_interpretation.negative: Not knowing which resource is the bottleneck — simplification will be misdirected.

probes.text: What reward does the customer get each time they use you — and does it vary?

signal_interpretation.positive: Reward jelas + ada unsur variabilitas (tribe/hunt/self) — engagement berkelanjutan mungkin
signal_interpretation.negative: Monotonous/predictable rewards — engagement will decay (finite variability)

probes.text: What have customers 'entrusted' to you (data, content, history, reputation) that makes it difficult for them to switch?

signal_interpretation.positive: Stored value membentuk switching cost nyata — retensi terjaga
signal_interpretation.negative: No stored value — the customer can leave without losing anything; zero switching cost

probes.text: Siapa habitual user Anda — mereka pakai seberapa sering, dan apa urutan aksi (Habit Path) mereka?

signal_interpretation.positive: Benchmark frequency + habit path codified from data — onboarding modifications can be data-driven
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak ada data frekuensi/path — retensi dikelola buta
